name: lemon_drizzle.docx
lines: 1. Heat oven to 180C/160C fan/gas 4. Line a 2lb loaf tin with baking parchment.
2. Beat together the butter and sugar until pale and creamy, then add the eggs one at a time.
3. Fold in the flour and lemon zest. Spoon into the tin and level the top.
4. Bake for 45-50 minutes until a skewer comes out clean.
5. Mix the lemon juice and sugar. Prick the warm cake all over and pour over the drizzle.
6. Leave in the tin until completely cool, about 30 minutes, then lift out and serve.

name: pancakes.xhtml
lines: 1. Mix the flour, baking powder and sugar in a large bowl.
2. Whisk the eggs, melted butter and milk together, then whisk into the dry ingredients. Leave the batter to rest for 10 minutes.
3. Heat a non-stick pan over a medium heat. Add a ladle of batter and cook for about 1½ minutes, until bubbles appear.
4. Flip and cook for 30 seconds - 1 minute on the other side.
5. Serve stacked with maple syrup and berries.
